subject: storytime
title: The Gruffalo words
about: A clever mouse walking through the woods invents a made-up monster to put off a hungry fox, an owl and a snake, and then comes face to face with the real thing. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, with him reading the animal words.

book.author: Julia Donaldson
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A small mouse outwits every creature in the wood, even the one he made up himself.

passage.text:
Gruffalo mouse wood fox
nut owl log snake
deep teeth monster trick
nose lunch scared said

cards.note: capital G, it is his name; three parts: Gruff-a-lo; ff is one f; the a says uh and the o says its name
ou says ow; se at the end just says s: mows
oo says the short oo, like in book
ow says ou, like in cow
s-n blend; magic e makes a say its name
ee says long e; th is one part
two parts: mon + ster; er says er
t-r blend; ck is one sound
magic e makes o say its name; the s says z
s-c blend; are says air here: skaird
the ai says e here, not long a: sed
